name: Fujishiro Takumi
source:
A regular human who is a 2nd year high school student at the normal human side of the school.
He was supposed to be the target of one of the protagonist's shinigami reaping jobs, but somehow he is mysteriously still alive.
Even though he is a human, he has a warped part about him and often has strange thoughts.
He loves drawing and is quite good at it, even the protagonist adores his skills.
